response.reason: In _exclusive_chunks' downward sweep, lane==right is assigned na = _compose(la, pa) (subtree total applied before the prefix-above), but the correct exclusive prefix is _compose(pa, la) (prefix-above applied first, then the left-half total). For C=4 (N>=25 gives chunks=4, padded=4) the last lane's exclusive chunk prefix is M1·M0·M2 instead of M2·M1·M0, so the carry for the final chunk and hence outputs for the last 8 steps are wrong for noncommuting matrices.
